evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Attenuated consistent with prior sprain.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, presumably related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Thin complete radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus within 1 cm of the attachment.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.PF OA: Moderate trochlear chondrosis with areas of high-grade partial and full-thickness cartilage loss at the central trochlea
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
